Messwert.Meldungstext:
\T\L\S\G\AAVS fault status of last switch (cylinder-specific)\L\S\K\N
The variable indicates the fault status of the last switch (exception: electrical faults; they are indicated by a separate fault memory entry). If the switch is error-free, the variable is 0. In the event of a fault, the variable indicates all switching operations which have not been performed on the corresponding cylinders. The cylinders are binary coded (in firing sequence). The following listing sets out all possible fault combinations.
0 = Switch fault-free 1 = Switch on cylinder 1 faulty 2 = Switch on cylinder 3 faulty 3 = Switch on cylinders 1 and 3 faulty 4 = Switch on cylinder 4 faulty 5 = Switch on cylinders 1 and 4 faulty 6 = Switch on cylinders 3 and 4 faulty 7 = Switch on cylinders 1, 3 and 4 faulty 8 = Switch on cylinder 2 faulty 9 = Switch on cylinders 1 and 2 faulty 10 = Switch on cylinders 2 and 3 faulty 11 = Switch on cylinders 1, 2 and 3 faulty 12 = Switch on cylinders 2 and 4 faulty 13 = Switch on cylinders 1, 2 and 4 faulty 14 = Switch on cylinders 2, 3 and 4 faulty 15 = Switch on cylinders 1, 2, 3 and 4 faulty \L\S\K\N
